sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: ITC India provides photometry testing for luminaires, LED products and UV light sources. Use the service links below to open each dedicated programme page for scope, method and enquiry.

sections.heading: Photometry Testing Services
paragraphs: These are the photometry programmes listed on this page — seven service links, each opening its dedicated laboratory page.
bullets: Luminaries/LED Product Testing — photometric evaluation for luminaires and LED lighting products.
LM-79 Testing — optical and electrical measurements of solid-state lighting as per IES LM-79.
LM-80 Testing — lumen maintenance testing for LED packages, arrays and modules.
Testing and Calibration of UV Lamp — UV lamp / UV light bulb testing programmes.
Testing and Calibration of UV Lamp — UV lamp calibration support for intensity verification.
Calibrating a UV intensity Meter — calibration of UV intensity meters for reliable irradiance readings.
Measuring UV intensity — measurement of UV intensity for lamps, processes and verification setups.
